knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A strong fragrance can cover an odour whose source is still present. The source has to be found and removed.
The check is made against the single target the business sets, not personal preference or the previous setting.
The mini-fridge is a common odour source and is checked inside and out, including the door seal.

practicalCriteria: Stands at the doorway on entry and names the first smell in a simulated room.
Finds a seeded odour source by working the set order of checks, and removes it using the approved method.
Records the temperature reading against the business target, and adjusts or reports as the procedure requires.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 percent pass mark (all three correct). Practical criteria are observed and signed off separately by an assessor. A knowledge pass is not practical competence.
evidenceRequired: Air and temperature record with time and reading
stopWorkCriteria: Fragrance used to mask an odour with the source still present
Heating or cooling equipment repaired by a person without the relevant licence
